title: 第 19 章此人根本就是个登徒子第 20 章外门弟子竟然如此猖狂
slug: 我被师姐凌辱你说我罪恶滔天
lines: “陈默你怎么会在这里？”
然而就在这时苏婉清站在楼梯口，在她看到陈默之后整个人就愣住了。
怎么也没想到会在藏经阁二楼看到陈默这个外门弟子。
而此时的陈默也刚刚才翻开那本深蓝色封面的书籍，随后一束光芒就从书页当中涌了出来直接钻进了他的掌心。
那光芒很刺眼整个二楼都被照得通亮。
当光芒散去之后陈默的手上多了一面镜子，只见镜框上刻着复杂的花纹还透着一股古朴的气息。
【恭喜宿主获得上品法器乾坤镜，该法器可在对敌时释放出强烈光芒令对方双眼无法睁开从而获得短暂出手的时机。】
当陈默看着手中的乾坤镜以后脸上就露出了满意的笑容，这系统虽然抽象但给的东西确实都是好东西啊。
上品法器这在青云宗内门都没有几个弟子能拥有，自己一个外门弟子手里却已经有了一件。
随后陈默就将乾坤镜收进了储物袋然后合上了手中的书。
正准备把书放回书架上的时候，身后传来了刚刚那个声音。
转过头就看到苏婉清站在楼梯口的位置正盯着他看，脸上的表情从疑惑逐渐变得有几分不悦。
“我问你话呢，你怎么会在这里。”苏婉清走了过来语气中带着质问的味道。
“这里是藏经阁二楼，只有内门弟子才能进你一个外门弟子谁让你上来的。”
然而陈默看着她脸上却没有什么表情，怎么又遇到这个女人了。
“我来找本书。”陈默淡淡道。
“找本书。”苏婉清冷笑了一声，“你一个外门弟子有什么资格来二楼找书分明是偷偷溜进来的。”
“守阁的前辈同意我上来的。”
“不可能，守阁的江前辈最重规矩怎么会让你一个外门弟子上二楼你少在这里胡说八道。”
但陈默懒得跟她多解释于是转身就要走，可刚迈出一步苏婉清就拦在了他面前。
“站住，我话还没说完呢你要去哪。”苏婉清说道。
“让开。”
“不让。”苏婉清盯着他的眼中也瞬间带着几分冷意，“上次在浴池的事情我还没跟你算账呢，今天你自己送上门来了就别想轻易走掉。”
“那次我已经解释过了我不是故意的。”陈默说道。
“不是故意的，你躲在浴池底下偷看我洗澡还说不是故意的你觉得我会信吗？”
只听陈默叹了口气他在心里想着这个女人怎么这么难缠，都已经解释过了她非是不信。
“上次我练功出了岔子真元无法运转让你捡了个便宜，今天可不一样了。”
说完苏婉清就抬起手调动体内的真元，一股强大的气势从她身上扩散出来。
“今天我要好好教训教训你这个不知天高地厚的登徒子，让你知道得罪我的下场。”话音刚落苏婉清一掌就朝陈默拍了过来，那掌风凌厉而且还带着破空之声。
此刻的陈默在看到这一掌之后心中一惊，这个女人的修为起码在元婴三层比他高了不少。
硬接肯定接不住，不过陈默心念一动立刻从储物袋中取出了乾坤镜。
就在苏婉清的掌风快要击中他的瞬间，陈默催动了乾坤镜。
一道刺目的光芒从镜面中爆发出来，整个二楼瞬间被白光吞没。
那苏婉清下意识的闭上了眼睛手上的动作也慢了下来，刚刚那光芒太亮刺的她什么都看不见。
而陈默也立刻抓住这个机会一掌拍在苏婉清的肩膀上，苏婉清的身体失去平衡后立刻就摔在了地上。
因此她下意识想要站起来可双眼还没有恢复过来，眼前一片模糊什么都看不清。
“你……你用了什么法器。”
此刻陈默并没有回答只是站在那里看着她。
“难道是乾坤镜，你手里拿的莫非是乾坤镜。”
陈默没有说话只是将乾坤镜收回了储物袋，苏婉清盯着他的眼神里充满了震惊。
content_en:
"Chen Mo, why are you here?"
However, at this moment Su Wanqing was standing at the top of the stairs, and she was stunned when she saw Chen Mo.
I never expected to see Chen Mo, an outer disciple, on the second floor of the Sutra Pavilion.
At this time, Chen Mo had just opened the book with a dark blue cover, and then a beam of light emerged from the pages and went directly into his palm.
The light was so dazzling that the entire second floor was illuminated.
When the light dissipated, Chen Mo had a mirror in his hand. The frame was engraved with complex patterns and exuded a simple atmosphere.
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining the high-grade magic weapon Qiankun Mirror. This magic weapon can release a strong light when facing the enemy, making it impossible for the opponent to open his eyes and giving him a short opportunity to take action. 】
When Chen Mo looked at the Universe Mirror in his hand, a satisfied smile appeared on his face. Although this system is abstract, the things it provides are indeed good things.
Not many disciples in the inner sect of Qingyun Sect can possess this high-grade magic weapon, but one of my outer sect disciples already has one.
Then Chen Mo put the Universe Mirror into his storage bag and closed the book in his hand.
Just as he was about to put the book back on the shelf, he heard the voice from behind.
Turning around, he saw Su Wanqing standing at the top of the stairs, staring at him, the expression on her face gradually changing from confusion to a bit displeased.
"I'm asking you, why are you here." Su Wanqing came over with a questioning tone in her voice.
"This is the second floor of the Sutra Pavilion. Only inner disciples can enter. You, an outer disciple, asked you to come up here."
However, Chen Mo looked at her with no expression on his face. Why did he meet this woman again.
"I'm looking for a book." Chen Mo said calmly.
"Looking for a book." Su Wanqing sneered, "What qualifications do you, an outer disciple, have to come to the second floor to look for a book? You obviously sneaked in secretly."
"The senior guarding the pavilion agreed to let me come up."
"Impossible. How can Senior Jiang, who guards the pavilion and is the most strict about rules, let you, an outer disciple, go to the second floor? Stop talking nonsense here."
But Chen Mo was too lazy to explain to her, so he turned around and left, but as soon as he took a step, Su Wanqing stopped in front of him.
"Stop, I haven't finished speaking yet. Where are you going?" Su Wanqing said.
"Get out of the way."
"No." Su Wanqing stared at him with a hint of coldness in her eyes, "I haven't settled the accounts with you about what happened in the bath last time. Don't even think about leaving easily after you showed up at your door today."
"I already explained that I didn't mean it that time." Chen Mo said.
"You didn't mean it. You hid under the bathtub and peeped at me taking a bath and you said you didn't mean it. Do you think I would believe it?"
Hearing Chen Mo sigh, he was thinking in his mind why this woman was so difficult to deal with. She had already explained it and she didn't believe it.
"Last time, something went wrong in my practice. My true energy couldn't circulate, so you took advantage of it. Today is different."
After saying this, Su Wanqing raised her hand to mobilize the true energy in her body, and a powerful momentum spread from her body.
"Today I'm going to teach you, a bastard who knows nothing about heaven and earth, the consequences of offending me." As soon as she finished speaking, Su Wanqing slapped Chen Mo with a palm. The wind of the palm was sharp and had the sound of breaking through the air.
At this moment, Chen Mo was shocked after seeing this palm. This woman's cultivation level was at least much higher than him at the third level of Nascent Soul.
He would definitely not be able to catch it hard, but Chen Mo immediately took out the Universe Mirror from the storage bag as soon as he thought about it.
Just when Su Wanqing's palm wind was about to hit him, Chen Mo activated the Universe Mirror.
A dazzling light burst out from the mirror, and the entire second floor was instantly engulfed in white light.
Su Wanqing subconsciously closed her eyes and slowed down the movements of her hands. The light just now was so bright that she couldn't see anything.
Chen Mo immediately seized this opportunity and slapped Su Wanqing on the shoulder. Su Wanqing lost her balance and immediately fell to the ground.
So she subconsciously wanted to stand up, but her eyes hadn't recovered yet, and her vision was blurry and she couldn't see anything clearly.
"You...what magic weapon did you use?"
At this moment, Chen Mo didn't answer but just stood there and looked at her.
"Could it be the Mirror of the Universe? What you are holding in your hand is the Mirror of the Universe."
Chen Mo didn't say anything but put the Universe Mirror back into the storage bag. Su Wanqing stared at him with shock in her eyes.
title_en: Chapter 19: This person is simply a disciple Chapter 20: The outer disciple is so rampant
